map.BOOI 与 BCI 是怎么算出来的？: How are BOOI and BCI calculated?
map.BOOI = Pdet@Qmax − 2×Qmax，>40 判为梗阻、20–40: BOOI = Pdet@Qmax - 2 x Qmax; >40 obstructed, 20-40 equivocal, <20 no obstruction. BCI = Pdet@Qmax + 5 x Qmax; >100 normal contractility, <100 reduced. The two must be read together: high pressure with low flow is obstruction, low pressure with low flow is weak contractility - the treatments differ completely.
